verdicts.explanation: The quoted sentence gives the ionic conductivity of CsPbI3 as 1x10-10 S/cm, which matches the record. The 40°C dark measurement temperature is stated in the Fig. 1 caption, and the experimental origin is correct. The 350°C anneal is a thin-film processing step, so leaving sintering fields null is acceptable.

The quoted sentence gives the FAPbI3 ionic conductivity as 2x10-9 S/cm, and the 40°C temperature comes from the Fig. 1 caption. The 0.6 eV activation energy is stated in the main text for FAPbI3 ("~0.6 eV, see SI"), so it is supported even though the SI measurement used a different iodine partial pressure.
